node: Vertical AI software, proprietary data, and workflow automation
summary: Expanded the node around vertical AI deployment rather than AI infrastructure. The reference anchor is Palantir, because it defines the high-attention production-AI workflow category. The underfollowed lane highlights smaller US-listed companies with domain datasets, regulated workflow embedding, or compliance-driven switching costs: CCC Intelligent Solutions in P&C insurance claims and repair workflows, Donnelley Financial Solutions in SEC disclosure and regulated financial-reporting workflows, and Certara in biosimulation, clinical-data, and regulatory drug-development workflows. These are research candidates, not recommendations; the key next step is to verify whether AI features are producing measurable revenue, retention, pricing, or workflow-share gains rather than marketing language.
